newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds sink on French election jitters.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds sink on French election jitters.

text.p: Portuguese bonds closed weaker with foreign markets amid concerns that the left could win second round French legislative elections on Sunday, and dealers said yield spreads could increase in the coming sessions.
The trend was uncertain and dealers said unfavourable events abroad could widen spreads against Bunds after Thursday's market holiday in Portugal.
"June futures are close to the 108.50 support level, and below that support level there is only firm ground between 107.25 and 107.50," said a technical analyst.
